messages:
Maya (Design): Uploaded a new compact quickstart pill layout in Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/aaaaaa/quickstart-pill. Goal: minimal vertical footprint, three visible sample projects, overflow for more.
Evan (PM): Love the compactness. Can we prioritize by cold-start latency and cost? Want the cheapest/fastest first.
Maya (Design): Plan: 'Tiny summarizer', 'FAQ intent classifier (micro)', 'Embeddings demo (quantized)'. Overflow labelled 'More starter projects'.
Sam (Frontend): Implementation notes: lazy-render thumbnails, use horizontal scroll with focusable items. CSS: `display:flex; gap:12px; overflow:auto; scroll-snap-type:x mandatory;` Keyboard nav + swipe needed.
Riley (A11y): Accessibility checklist: 1) Each card needs role="button" and aria-label including project name and estimated run time. 2) Provide an SR-only counter: "Showing 1 of 3 starter projects". 3) Do not auto-focus the strip. 4) Contrast issue: some card captions fail AA on mobile.
Maya (Design): I'll bump caption weight and darken card surface to improve contrast. Also adding an unobtrusive keyboard hint pill: "Press / to open quickstart" with SR text.
Sam (Frontend): Added live-region announce when overflow menu opens: `aria-live="polite"` with text "Opened starter projects list". Fixed earlier bug where focus order jumped after opening overflow.
Evan (PM): Copy tweak: change CTA from "Get started" to "Run in workspace" — clearer intent. Also change overflow tooltip to "See more starter projects".
Riley (A11y): When overflow menu is keyboard-opened, trap focus inside it and ensure Escape closes it. If opened by mouse, avoid forcing focus. Also check that the hint pill is reachable by keyboard and not announced on page load.
ci-bot: Preview build ready: https://preview.internal/changes/10021 :white_check_mark:
Sam (Frontend): Preview looks good on Chrome & Safari, mobile swipe and keyboard nav tested. Contrast now passes AA on simulated devices.
Maya (Design): I'll upload final assets and the a11y checklist to the ticket. Ready for beta roll out to ~5% of new signups. Thanks! :rocket:
